slides.kicker: How I found my startup idea
slides.h1: Good startup ideas already have bad workarounds.

slides.h2: In big towers, nobody knows their neighbors.
slides.lead: Hundreds of people under one roof. Almost zero connection.

slides.h2: People are already trying. The tools just don't fit.
slides.lead: When people hack together a fix, the need is real. That gap is your opening.
A community app just for residents of the same building. Meet neighbors, organize meetups, help each other.

points: Build the thing that actually fits
